summary: Regression testing of the 4 post-audit fixes (P0-2 LID send target, P0-3 phone_is_lid flag, P2 geocoding throttle, duplicate /api/motor-ia/budget route). New pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter255_audit_fixes.py: 16/17 passed. All 4 fixes VERIFIED working. One CRITICAL pre-existing/unrelated defect found: /app/backend/services/ai_orchestrator.py has a SyntaxError (truncated function at line 553-556) so the whole AI orchestrator module fails to import on EVERY inbound WhatsApp message ('[wa-baileys] orchestrator skip: invalid syntax'). Frontend WhatsApp panel loads without white screen and renders the 'LID' badge + 'LID anonimo' thread badge + 'Vincular telefone' button correctly.

critical.issue: SyntaxError: file is TRUNCATED mid-statement inside _truck_roll_guard_context (lines 553-555: 'off = await db.subscribers.count_documents({ "company_id": company_id, "cto_id": sub["cto_id"],' never closed, followed directly by 'async def _premium_repair_context'). ast.parse fails at line 557. Consequence: `from services.ai_orchestrator import build_orchestrated_context` raises on every inbound msg and is swallowed by the except at whatsapp_baileys.py:2584 -> log '[wa-baileys] orchestrator skip: invalid syntax'. Truck Roll Guard, Reparo Premium, recurrence context and all orchestrated context are 100% DISABLED in production. Not fixed by me: the missing lines are business logic (CTO offline % computation) and must be restored by the dev agent.

minor.issue: Backend correctly returns 502 {'detail':'WhatsApp nao confirmou entrega: WhatsApp nao conectado.'} on localhost:8001, but through the public ingress the 502 is replaced by a Cloudflare HTML error page (content-type text/html). Frontend error handlers that read e.response.data.detail will get HTML instead of the message. Consider returning 200/409 with delivery_status='failed' in the JSON body instead of a 5xx for handled delivery failures.

4/8 legacy tests fail due to test-data pollution (wa_lid_map keeps lid 999999999999999 -> 5521977770000 from a previous run, so the 'pure LID' inbound now resolves to the real phone). Product behaviour is correct; the test fixture only deletes conversations, not wa_lid_map. Not a regression.

integration_issues.issue: The chat layout is gated behind sidecar connection (WhatsAppQRPanel returns <WhatsAppChatLayout/> only when status=connected/sticky). With the Baileys sidecar logged out (expected in preview) the operator only sees the QR screen and cannot read conversation history. To verify the UI I stubbed only GET /api/whatsapp-baileys/qr -> {status:'connected'} in Playwright; with that, wa-chat-layout rendered, 173 conversation nodes, 6 LID badges, no page errors.

rca_of_the_issue: ai_orchestrator.py: a previous edit truncated _truck_roll_guard_context, leaving an unclosed dict literal in the count_documents call at line 553; Python cannot compile the module, so the lazy import inside _maybe_auto_reply raises SyntaxError which is caught and logged at INFO level, silently disabling all orchestrated AI context. Reproduce: python -c "import ast;ast.parse(open('/app/backend/services/ai_orchestrator.py').read())" -> SyntaxError line 557; or POST /api/whatsapp-baileys/inbound and grep backend log for 'orchestrator skip'. Mitigation: restore the missing statements and add a startup import check for services/ai_orchestrator.py.
